documented: the official spec lists fields 'DateTime Stamp;Bar OPEN Bid Quote;Bar HIGH Bid Quote;Bar LOW Bid Quote;Bar CLOSE Bid Quote;Volume' - it names the OHLC fields but never states whether the DateTime Stamp marks the bar's open or close
structural_evidence_L7: the daily break is stamped as a gap 16:59:59 -> 18:00:00. Under OPEN labelling the missing stamps 17:00..17:59 are exactly the non-trading hour and the 16:59 bar covers 16:59-17:00 (the last traded minute) - consistent. Under CLOSE labelling the stamp 17:00 would be the bar covering 16:59-17:00 which DID trade, so it should exist - inconsistent.
